commentary.text: 90+10' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Edinson Cavani (Uruguay) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+10' Jose Maria Gimenez (Uruguay) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) fires the resultant free kick towards the left post, but the keeper makes a brilliant save and denies him the chance to score.
90+9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alidu Seidu (Ghana) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+8' Substitution. Issahaku Fatawu (Ghana) has come on for Mohammed Kudus.
90+7' Sebastian Coates (Uruguay) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.

90+6' What a sweet touch by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him!
90+6' Uruguay take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+5' Maximiliano Gomez (Uruguay) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Lawrence Ati-Zigi gets down to his right to keep it out. The ball goes out of play and Uruguay have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Osman Bukari (Ghana) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90+3' Edinson Cavani (Uruguay) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+2' Antoine Semenyo (Ghana) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+2' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Thomas Partey (Ghana) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Lawrence Ati-Zigi (Ghana) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
89' Edinson Cavani (Uruguay) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
88' Daniel Amartey (Ghana) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
87' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Sebastian Coates (Uruguay) for his blatant foul.
86' Daniel Siebert shows the yellow card to Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) for a heavy challenge.
85' Abdul-Rahman Baba (Ghana) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Ghana failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

82' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Sergio Rochet sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Ghana.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Agustin Canobbio (Uruguay) is brought on as a substitute for Darwin Nunez.
80' Diego Alonso prepares a substitution. Giorgian de Arrascaeta is replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Uruguay).
80' Antoine Semenyo (Ghana) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
79' A cross from Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
78' Wasted effort! Federico Valverde (Uruguay) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
76' The corner from Daniel-Kofi Kyereh (Ghana) is hurriedly cleared.
76' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Ghana.
76' The attendance is 43443.
72' Otto Addo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel-Kofi Kyereh (Ghana) replacing Salis Abdul Samed.
72' Substitution. Antoine Semenyo (Ghana) replaces Inaki Williams.
72' What a long-range shot by Mohammed Kudus (Ghana). Unfortunately for him, his shot goes just a few inches over the bar.

70' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) receives the ball and fires a first-time shot from long range. His brilliant effort towards the left post is blocked by Lawrence Ati-Zigi, who pulls off a stunning save!
69' The corner from Abdul-Rahman Baba (Ghana) is cleared away by the defence.

69' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Good work from Ghana as they win a corner.
67' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Siebert signals a foul.
66' Diego Alonso has decided to make a change. Nicolas de la Cruz (Uruguay) replaces Facundo Pellistri.

64' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Osman Bukari, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
63' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Guillermo Varela (Uruguay) brought his opponent down.
60' The game is interrupted. Luis Suarez (Uruguay) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
59' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Uruguay, play can continue.
58' Referee Daniel Siebert makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Uruguay. Let’s see what happens!
57' Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
57' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) meets a cross inside the box, but Sergio Rochet wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
56' Jose Maria Gimenez (Uruguay) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
54' A clumsy foul by Mohammed Salisu (Ghana) and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. Uruguay get a free kick.
53' Salis Abdul Samed (Ghana) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
51' Mathias Olivera (Uruguay) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
49' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Osman Bukari (Ghana).
48' Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
47' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) is flagged for offside.
46' The game is over for Jordan Ayew. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Ghana) comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Otto Addo decided to make a change. Andre Ayew is replaced by Osman Bukari (Ghana).
46' Referee Daniel Siebert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+6' Jose Maria Gimenez (Uruguay) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
45+4' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul after Jordan Ayew (Ghana) hacks down one of his opponents.
45+4' Giorgian de Arrascaeta (Uruguay) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45+2' Guillermo Varela (Uruguay) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lawrence Ati-Zigi intercepts the ball.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
45' Giorgian de Arrascaeta (Uruguay) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
45' Thomas Partey (Ghana) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. Uruguay are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
43' Alidu Seidu (Ghana) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
43' Alidu Seidu (Ghana) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
42' Salis Abdul Samed (Ghana) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniel Siebert signals.

39' Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
38' The corner kick from Jordan Ayew (Ghana) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
37' Jordan Ayew (Ghana) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Ghana are going to take it.

37' Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and Ghana manage to earn a corner.
37' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:4. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:3.
34' Rodrigo Bentancur is substituted due to injury. Diego Alonso gives a chance to Matias Vecino (Uruguay).
33' Rodrigo Bentancur (Uruguay) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

32' 0 - 2 Goal! Giorgian de Arrascaeta (Uruguay) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the back of the net. Luis Suarez assisted in the goal. 0:2.
31' Alidu Seidu (Ghana) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Siebert stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
30' Rodrigo Bentancur (Uruguay) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Alidu Seidu (Ghana) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Rochet, who smothers the ball.
26' 0 - 1 An unlucky rebound falls to Giorgian de Arrascaeta (Uruguay) and he scores with a bullet header.
26' Luis Suarez (Uruguay) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Lawrence Ati-Zigi reacts superbly to deny him.
24' The resulting set piece from Uruguay is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

24' Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) latches on to a pass inside the box and strikes the ball to the middle of the goal, but one of the defending players makes a goal-line clearance. Uruguay force a corner. They send men into the box.
22' Daniel Siebert blows the whistle, Rodrigo Bentancur (Uruguay) is penalised for a foul.
21' Andre Ayew (Ghana) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat Sergio Rochet who easily stops the effort.
20' Andre Ayew (Ghana) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
20' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) is given a yellow card.
19' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Ghana!
17' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Siebert must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Ghana using VAR. This could be interesting!
16' PENALTY APPEAL after Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

16' Inaki Williams (Ghana) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Sergio Rochet.
14' Darwin Nunez nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Luis Suarez (Uruguay), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
13' Giorgian de Arrascaeta (Uruguay) sends a cross into the box, but Lawrence Ati-Zigi comes off his line to gather the ball.
12' Daniel Siebert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Salis Abdul Samed (Ghana).
10' Federico Valverde (Uruguay) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
9' Facundo Pellistri (Uruguay) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
8' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and it's Abdul-Rahman Baba (Ghana) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
7' Rodrigo Bentancur (Uruguay) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Darwin Nunez (Uruguay) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Guillermo Varela (Uruguay) tries to find Facundo Pellistri, but he puts too much power on the pass.
1' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle. Mohammed Kudus (Ghana) commits a foul after dangerous play.
